projects.title: WhatsApp AI Appointment & Support Agent
projects.subtitle: Conversational assistance connected to scheduling and ticket capture
projects.overview: An n8n workflow connects incoming WhatsApp messages to an AI assistant with conversation memory and tools for scheduling and support. The agent can retrieve Google Calendar events, create appointments and append ticket records to Google Sheets before sending a reply through WhatsApp.

images.caption: WhatsApp message intake, AI agent processing, scheduling and ticket tools, and response delivery.

keyFeatures.title: Google Calendar event retrieval for availability checks

detailSections.title: Project overview
detailSections.body: An n8n workflow connects incoming WhatsApp messages to an AI assistant with conversation memory and tools for scheduling and support. The agent can retrieve Google Calendar events, create appointments and append ticket records to Google Sheets before sending a reply through WhatsApp.

detailSections.title: How the workflow fits together
detailSections.body: A WhatsApp message triggers the workflow and passes through a conditional gate. The AI Agent uses an OpenAI chat model and Simple Memory, with connected tools to retrieve calendar events, create appointments and append support tickets to a sheet. The resulting response is sent back through WhatsApp.

detailSections.title: Connected agent tools
items: check_availability retrieves Google Calendar events to inform scheduling.
create_ticket appends a record to Google Sheets.
